column1: # MIRROR.tsv — papers whose edition lives in ~/danish-texts and is mirrored here.
# danish-texts is the SOURCE. `make mirror` (mirror.sh) copies each listed
# <name>.tex and <name>.pdf from the source directory into the destination,
# keeping their timestamps, so a correction made in danish-texts reaches this
# repo on the next `make mirror` (publish-relativity.sh runs it). Never edit the
# copies here: the next mirror overwrites them.
